name: AURO
recent: AURO 正在推进最多占已发行股份 10% 的私募配售，第二批次 16,250,000 股已于 2026 年 11 月 4 日上市，配售价为每股 RM0.1168。公司已向 Bursa Securities 申请延长私募实施期限，并于 2026 年 11 月 12 日获得 6 个月延期至 2027 年 5 月 20 日。公司同时更改财政年度结束日。
notable: 第二批次私募配售的 16,250,000 股新股已于 2026 年 11 月 4 日上市，配售价为每股 RM0.1168。
Bursa Securities 于 2026 年 11 月 12 日批准将私募配售的实施期限延长 6 个月至 2027 年 5 月 20 日。
公司更改财政年度结束日。
risks: 私募配售最多占已发行股份 10%，涉及新股发行。
私募配售实施期限已延长至 2027 年 5 月 20 日，尚未完成。

news.title: Auro Holdings Fixes Private Placement Price at RM0.1168, a 9.95% Discount

recent_en: AURO is undertaking a private placement of up to 10% of its issued shares, with the second tranche of 16,250,000 shares listed on 4 November 2026 at an issue price of RM0.1168 per share. The Company applied to Bursa Securities for an extension of time to implement the private placement and was granted a 6-month extension until 20 May 2027 on 12 November 2026. The Company also changed its financial year end.
notable_en: The second tranche of 16,250,000 placement shares was listed on 4 November 2026 at an issue price of RM0.1168 per share.
Bursa Securities approved a 6-month extension until 20 May 2027 for the implementation of the private placement on 12 November 2026.
The Company changed its financial year end.
risks_en: The private placement of up to 10% of issued shares involves the issuance of new shares.
The implementation period for the private placement has been extended to 20 May 2027 and is not yet completed.
